{{Infobox auto}}

A '''puerquito''' is a pig-shaped molasses cookie that heals {{Value|Puerquito|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Puerquito|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/puerquito.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Molasses]], sugar, estus ash and dough make 2. Obtaining molasses unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a puerquito takes {{Value|Puerquito|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Puerquito|heals}} and gives Regeneration {{Value|Puerquito|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Puerquito|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_28.mcfunction}}</ref>
